items.label: Core Idea
items.subtitle: Physics-based third-person controller template — fluid, responsive movement.

items.label: Gameplay
items.subtitle: Move, jump, and dash through space using camera-relative controls and physics momentum.

items.label: Mechanics
items.subtitle: Kinematic physics and a rule-based state machine create predictable, tunable movement.

items.label: Game Feel
items.subtitle: Weighty, grounded, responsive — feels great to move in before content is added.
